title: Microsoft Viva: SharePoint agent analytics in Viva Insights
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly makes uploading organisational data a dashboard prerequisite, although Microsoft documents Microsoft Entra ID as the default data source. Its automatic-access description also omits the exception for Global Administrators in PIM-enabled tenants. The roadmap facts and the listed control paths and commands are supported.

claims.claim: The printed Microsoft 365 admin center path reaches Agent Dashboard > Add policy through the documented feature access management route.
claims.quote: Go to the Settings tab and select Microsoft Viva, then Viva Insights. On this page, go to the Set up and management tab. Under Access Management, select Turn Advanced Insights on or off. On the Feature access management page, select Agent Dashboard and Add policy.

claims.claim: The printed Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy call disables AgentDashboard for everyone using valid parameters and the documented feature ID.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Agent Dashboard for all users in your tenant. ModuleId : VivaInsights FeatureId : AgentDashboard Name : DisableFeatureForAll IsFeatureEnabled : false Everyone

claims.claim: The printed web app path reaches the documented Users > Add control in Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Settings ... Microsoft Viva, then Viva Insights ... Set up and management ... Under Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, select Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard. At the top, select Users. ... At the bottom, select Add.

claims.claim: The printed Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy call disables the Viva Insights web app for everyone using the documented feature ID.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant. ModuleId : VivaInsights FeatureId : Viva Insights web app Name : DisableFeatureForAll IsFeatureEnabled : false Everyone

claims.claim: For tenants without a Viva Insights licence the printed path reaches Manage minimum group size in Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: If your tenant does not have a Viva Insights license ... go to the Settings tab and select Microsoft Viva, then Microsoft Viva Insights. Under Copilot Dashboard in Microsoft 365, select Manage minimum group size.

claims.claim: Automation for changing the minimum group size is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights minimum group size privacy settings PowerShell Microsoft Graph API; "minimum group size" "Viva" "API" "PowerShell". Opened dashboard settings, Customize Viva Insights privacy settings and Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy; found UI settings, no threshold-setting operation.
